kinds.name: notifier
kinds.doc:
A place notices are sent to.

`describe` answers the same on every call with nothing run. `reply` and `withdraw` have defaults that say there is no answer and
nothing to take away.

slots.name: describe
slots.doc: What this notifier is and the settings it takes.

slots.name: send
slots.doc: Delivers one notice. The host calls it on a thread of its own and does not retry a failure.

slots.name: reply
slots.doc: The person's answer to a delivered notice, waiting at most `wait_ms`. The default: none.

slots.name: withdraw
slots.doc: Takes a delivered notice away, when it was answered somewhere else. The default: nothing.
